max_rounds.description: Repair rounds after the first draft; an item still invalid after them is discarded.
max_rounds.title: Max Rounds

stronger_repair_from.description: The repair round from which the `repair` role's model takes over; the generating model repairs before it. 1: the larger model does every repair.
stronger_repair_from.title: Stronger Repair From

repair_temperature_step.description: Repair round N asks at temperature N x step (at most 0.8); the first draft asks at 0.
repair_temperature_step.title: Repair Temperature Step

thinking.description: The generating model reasons at length before writing the exercise.
thinking.title: Thinking

concept_lines.description: The most lines of a learn-mode question's Concept section.
concept_lines.title: Concept Lines

max_tokens.description: Output tokens per reply when the model thinks (its reasoning counts as output).
max_tokens.title: Max Tokens

max_tokens_no_thinking.description: Output tokens per reply when the model does not think.
max_tokens_no_thinking.title: Max Tokens No Thinking

item_token_budget.description: Input and output tokens per item over all rounds; repairs stop once it is spent.
item_token_budget.title: Item Token Budget

context_chars.description: Characters of course pages a prompt may hold; a longer lecture is cut to the item's slides.
context_chars.title: Context Chars

max_count.description: At most this many exercises when the plan chooses how many.
max_count.title: Max Count

parallel.description: Exercises generated at once; empty: one per four CPU cores, 1 to 4 (each validation runs Spark on every core).
parallel.title: Parallel

mode.description: learn: questions may explain the cause of a bug; review: only its symptom.
mode.title: Mode
